title: Motion Explainer
description: An individual skill I developed within my fork of Anthropic's Skills repository. It creates animated, step-by-step visual explanations of concepts using p5.js, with support for interactive prediction, parameter sliders, misconception scenes, mathematical notation, and 2D/3D visualizations.
longDescription: Motion Explainer is a reusable skill for turning concepts into animated visual narratives. It structures an explanation around a clear conceptual arc, then builds it as a sequence of scenes using a fixed viewer template. The skill supports p5.js animation, KaTeX-rendered mathematics, interactive prediction pauses, misconception scenes, parameter controls, responsive 2D or WEBGL rendering, and reusable animation and drawing primitives. The implementation lives specifically in the motion-explainer directory of my fork of Anthropic's Skills repository. The other skills in that fork are upstream Anthropic work and are not part of this project.
